quote: Globex will provide the customer with at least 30 days' written notice before engaging any new subprocessor. The customer may object to a new subprocessor within 15 days, in which case Globex will either propose an alternative or the customer may terminate the Agreement.
policy_quote: Vendor must notify us in writing at least 30 days before adding a new subprocessor. Violation: no notice requirement, or notice <30 days.
reason: Prior written notice is at least 30 days, which meets the requirement. The objection right is additional and not required by the policy.
